hero.title: Hey, I'm Elad.
hero.copy: I work across product analytics, data science, and BI, helping teams turn messy product questions into clear event design, experiments, dashboards, and decisions. I enjoy building practical tools that reduce friction in real workflows, from analytics utilities to Chrome extensions and lightweight web apps.

panels.title: Professional Experience
panels.body: Product analytics, BI, experimentation, dashboarding, event taxonomy, funnel analysis, retention analysis, and stakeholder reporting.

panels.title: Skills and Tools
